notes.title: 1 Week to Release. Thank you everybody.
notes.notes:
Dear Fiends,

We're excited to announce that "Vorax" is just one week away from releasing in Early Access on July 18th.
 To celebrate this milestone, we released a new teaser trailer that encapsulates the essence of the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lMSHbFGU1L4

The journey to this point has been one of relentless effort, passion and dedication. Over the past three years, our team has poured blood, sweat, and tears into finding the perfect balance between survival and horror mechanics. We hope we have succeeded, we will submit to your judgment and we will always try to improve during Early Access.
Furthermore, from an artistic point of view we have always followed our vision and are immensely proud of the monster designs, and we sincerely hope that players enjoy all of these elements as much as we do.

Early Access and Beyond
As we embark on this early access journey, we are committed to continually updating and improving "Vorax." Our goal is to add tons of new content over the next year, with the aim of crafting the best survival horror experience out there. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game, and we look forward to evolving and enhancing the world of "Vorax" together with our community.

We would never have made this release without the support of our community and all Indiegala users that loved our website and our games.
Thanks to everyone who supported us and will support us. Thank you on behalf of the entire Indiegala team.

Stay vigilant and prepare for the horrors that await. Watch the teaser trailer now and get ready to dive into "Vorax" on July 18th.

notes.title: Die Young is out on PS4 & a new PC 1.2.5 Update!
notes.notes:
Die Young is now available on PlayStation 4
https://i.imgur.com/XibGgcm.png
Happy New Year! 2020 has been a long year full of unpleasant surprises, but we wanted to start 2021 strong and with two pleasant surprises.

Firstly, Die Young is now available on the PlayStation Store. We know it may seem a bit odd to some for us to post an announcement here on Steam, but we simply couldn't contain our excitement and we wanted to share it with our fans, especially the ones who have been requesting this version for a while now. 

Die Young is out now on PS4 in English, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish (screen languages). For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent.

Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.

Secondly, we have not forgotten about our PC fans. Die Young just got updated on Steam. Here are the release notes:

Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:

CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5

- fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).

- fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)

- fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)

- fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)

- AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)

- Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)

- fix for bug in  The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)

- fix for various graphic bugs

- various fixes in level design

Enjoy!

notes.title: Gates Of Nowhere - Version 1.2 released
notes.notes:
2 new Alchemical Items unlocked
MIMESIS and GRAVITA are now available

https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohs4wi70wuz2heSkM/giphy.gif

https://media.giphy.com/media/d3YIXNlDjjiuLwgU/giphy.gif

OCULUS support improvements
Following your precious suggestions and feedback, we improved a lot the Oculus support. Now you can see the 3D model of Oculus Touch controllers

There are 2 different Oculus Touch control mapping.

MODE A: Use the Left thumbstick to MOVE and the Right thumbstick to STRAFE. Click the B/Y buttons to rotate the view

MODE B: Use the Left thumbstick to MOVE and the Right thumbstick to ROTATE the view.

https://media.giphy.com/media/l1KcPFFHyvMY1IjsY/giphy.gif

VIVE support improved
We added to different VIVE stick control mapping.

MODE A: is the default configuration you played from the beginning

MODE B: simply touch the Left thumbstick to MOVE and click the Right thumbstick to activate the Teleport.

To switch the control mapping between hands, click and hold both thumbsticks for a second.

LongBow updated
Now the LONGBOW has a limited numer of arrows (25), and the recharge is automatic and time based

https://media.giphy.com/media/26DN68f4TBwDk31Kg/giphy.gif

New menu option
Now you can hide the energy bar above the enemies in the Option Menu.

Multi-Slot saving system.
Now you have many different Slots to save your progress.

https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOwFTuMUf9Kw5bWWk/giphy.gif

Various bug fixes.

notes.title: Gates Of Nowhere - Version 1.1 released
notes.notes:
The long awaited 1.1 release is finally OUT! We apologize for the long wait, but as you can see you'll find tons of new features, content and fixes.
As always below you can find a detailed description:

Chapter 3 "WATERWORKS" unlocked. This completely new game level will offer more clues to solve, introducing new enemies and weapons.

New Enemy
Introducing the Water Worms creature.

https://media.giphy.com/media/xT0xexTgmWbHe40X1m/giphy.gif

New Enemies A.I.
We re-engineered it from scratch. Not all the enemies are deeply affected yet, but now you’ll face enemies equipped with weapons and armor, which are now stronger and challenging. We'll still improve them during the next releases.

https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOxf7DIfQidAbLRhm/giphy.gif

New Enemies Animation Set
All the enemies now have a completely new set of animations which is based on Root Motion, so it looks better and more realistic.

https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6fIVjkZvI3izo1Fu/giphy.gif

Desmemberment System
Now you can cut an enemy in pieces.

https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6fJbLieEKw8lqzwQ/giphy.gif

New Weapons Unlocked
We implemented the LongBow and the Spear.

https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6fJ3bXrMkD4d408w/giphy.gif

Introducing Workshop
In this release we unlocked the Workshops, in which you can create 13 different alchemical items. In order to create them you have to gather ingredients all around the game levels. Any recipe has a specified quantity of ingredients. Here is a list of the available alchemical items.
 Pathfinder, Plasma Shield, Momentum, Blackrift, Re-genesis, White Noise, Frostbite, Inferno, Grinder, Berserker, Sunburst, Detector, Portal.

https://media.giphy.com/media/xT0xepucuJaHWcYt8Y/giphy.gif

https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6fJeniwZAH21saBO/giphy.gif

Inventory Upadated
The inventory shows the name of the highlighted item/weapon. 
You can now see the status of the equipment for each hand.

IMPORTANT - Now you have to use the Trigger Button to pickup the highlighted item/weapon. You can't no longer use the Touchpad Button.

Environment Interaction Enhanced
Now you can grab and interact with many objects inside the world.

https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOxf6SF0qgXueWpr2/giphy.gif

Recharge Action When you put the hand inside the blue flame, it will repair only the equipped weapons. So if you do not have any weapon in your hand you'll not be able to repair them. The recharging time has been slowed down.

Destructible Weapons
Now all the weapons can be damaged by using them and become useless . In order to use them again you have to repair them, or pick up the weapons dropped by the enemy which will substitute the broken ones.

Oculus Support
We added a full Oculus compatibility. Keep in mind that  it is an early stage so please report any bug or give us suggestions about the key mapping.

https://media.giphy.com/media/l0CLURawsIJ8Ri4Ja/giphy.gif

Sound Improvements
We are still improving the soundtrack and sound FX.

notes.title: Gates Of Nowhere - Version 1.0.3 released
notes.notes:
Here's a new release for you with a lot of cool features, take a look below for a detailed description:

FULL LOCOMOTION
We finally implemented a Full Locomotion system, so now you can simply click and hold the trackpad in order to activate it and then slide the finger on the trackpad to move. You can control the movement speed by sliding the thumb closer to the edge of the trackpad.
By default you have both locomotion systems available, so you can still use the Teleportation like it was in the last release, or you can move by using the Full Locomotion. You can also disable the Locomotion inside the Menu if you do not want to use it at all.

https://media.giphy.com/media/hXzX3HrPF4c6c/giphy.gif

New weapons UNLOCKED
We unlocked 3 new weapons, MACE, AXE and the METAL SHIELD and you can grab them as soon as the enemies die and drop them off. So now you can play with 6 different weapons!

https://media.giphy.com/media/vTZJLGQQvPCU0/giphy.gif

Dynamically switch items
You can now switch an item between hands, by simply clicking the trigger (pick up button) on the picked object and it will automatically switch over to the other hand. Keep in mind that in order to switch an object, the target hand must be free.

https://media.giphy.com/media/MPOFRiesLWcI8/giphy.gif

Introducing the Crafting System Workbench
This is not available yet, but now you can take a look at the room of the upcoming item's Crafting System in which you'll be able to build up to 15 different alchemical recipes to use in game. Take a look at the home page to see what's coming next!

https://media.giphy.com/media/sxxK4umyROz1S/giphy.gif

Sound fixes
We are still improving the sound. A major fix will hopefully come in the 1.1 big update.

We really hope that you'll enjoy this release, especially the FULL LOCOMOTION. Please keep giving us feedback and help us improve the game.

notes.title: Gates Of Nowhere - Version 1.0.2 released
notes.notes:
Another minor release for you, below you can find a detailed description:

- Sound: 
All sounds in the game have been improved a little bit .
IMPORTANT NOTE: the problem and the issue you experienced with some sound banks is related to 3DAudio (spatialization) management. We temporarily modified a lot of 3D audio sources in order to avoid this problem, but Keep in mind that this issue is not related to our implementation, but it is a consequence of how the engine we are using manages the 3D Audio with a VR Headset. We noticed this problem in many other VR games and we know that the solution is on the way, but we have to wait until it will be solved. 

- Graphics improvements: 
We added some details in a few rooms in order to make them more beautiful. New rooms will be available to explore as the development goes on.

- Interaction improvements: 
Following your precious suggestions we modified some interaction implementation, for example now you have to manually rotate the key in the keyhole in order to open a door. We added also a new small puzzle, this is just a tiny sample of what you can expect as soon as we unlock the third chapter: "THE WATERWORKS".

Have fun with this update and keep giving us feedback!

notes.title: Gates Of Nowhere - Version 1.0.1 released
notes.notes:
Hi guys thanks for your suggestions and feedback.
We released the first Minor release which will patch some issues. Below you can find a detailed description:

- We changed the teleportation system to a more standard look. We removed the Avatar completely. Instead we added a runic circle that will serve as the teleport target. The teleport has a maximum range of a few meters. Moreover we added a cooldown (a charging timer). Both these changes are needed for major gameplay features to work and can't be removed. Please keep giving us feedback on this.

- The Torch will now have a reduced light when it overlapses with objects, along with a vibration feedback and deactivated shadows. This is to improve the visual impact when the light enters an object. 

- You may now calibrate the Brightness of the game. We added the option to open or close the camera lens, giving you freedom to have the dungeon look brighter than before. 

- We slightly changed the damage you do to enemies and the threshold of the movement required to deal it. You now need to hit harder to do more damage and very slow and short strikes will NOT be read as damage at all. This is just a quick fix to a small problem, a major overhaul of the combat system will come soon.

- Various Bugfixes

We really hope that you'll enjoy the game, and keep talking with us in order to improve the experience.

Thanks another time for your great support.

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed
